detail.title: 8CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5808S-I3 8CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 8-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 5M-N@20fps/1080p@25fps Encoding Capability • Max. 12-ch IP Video Input (Up to 6MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 4-ch Perimeter Protection, 8-ch SMD, 8-ch AI Coding • 8 Bays. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Mode: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels (up to 8 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

AI Video Quality Analytics.AI Video Quality Analytics by Recorder: 8 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast levels, black and white

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 12 channels of IPC access 4 IP channels by default +8 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 64 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 64 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 64 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, SMD, Perimeter Protection and QuickPick 2.0 cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Encode Enhancement disabled： Main stream: Channels 1-2 5M-N@(1 fps–25 fps), others 5M-N@(1 fps–12 fps); Channels 1-2 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–25/30 fps), others 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps); Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps); Encode Enhancement enabled： Main stream: Channels 1-4 5M-N@(1 fps–20 fps), others 5M-N@(1 fps-12 fps); (4 channels can be transformed to 5MP@6 fps) Channels 1-4 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–25 fps), others 4M-N@(1 fps–15 fps)/1080p@(1 fps–12 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps); Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps); *When Encode Enhancement is enabled,Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, Perimeter Protection and QuickPick 2.0 cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; alarm; motion detection; intelligent; POS
Recording Playback.Recording Playback: 1/4/9 It changes to 1/4 split when Face or IVS&SMD is selected in AI Mode.
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Alarm Output: 6 channels (5-channel relay output, 1-channel 12 V 1 A output)
Ports.Disk Interface: 8 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
Ports.USB: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 2.0 ports)
